title: EPA AQS Alameda County PM2.5 2025 Q3 snapshot
description: A planned immutable official-source PM2.5 snapshot for Alameda County, California.
station_selection_protocol: Include predetermined Alameda County AQS sites and preserve site identifiers.
quality_control_protocol: Preserve AQS qualifiers, methods, sample duration and deterministic HeatSafe checks.
missing_data_policy: Do not impute the raw normalized snapshot; document completeness separately.
known_limitations: Monitoring-site coverage is not equivalent to population exposure.
AQS sample records may use multiple instruments and durations.
